name: Distillates (petroleum), chemically neutralized light; Kerosine - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons produced by a treating process to remove acidic materials. It consists of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C9 through C16 and boiling in the range of approximately 150 °C to 290 °C (302 °F to 554 °F).]
